definitions.explanation: To get off one vehicle and board another to continue a journey.
To change from one thing to another (e.g., changing providers or methods).

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京駅|とうきょうえき}→東京駅：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乗|の}り{換|か}えて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{換|か}える。
examples.notes: に marks what you're transferring to

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{換|か}えなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}ける→いける：06957_ikeru⟧。
examples.english: You can go there without transferring.

examples.notes: Shows transfer between different vehicle types

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xで{乗|の}り{換|か}える (transfer at X) / Xに{乗|の}り{換|か}える (transfer to X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action. {乗|の}り{換|か}えている = 'has transferred.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{電車|でんしゃ}を{乗|の}り{換|か}える (transfer trains)
・Xで{乗|の}り{換|か}える (transfer at X station)
・Xに{乗|の}り{換|か}える (transfer to X line/train)
・{乗|の}り{換|か}え (transfer—noun)
・{乗|の}り{換|か}え{案内|あんない} (transfer information)

COMPOUND VERB: This is a compound of {乗|の}る (to ride) + {換|か}える (to change).

TRAVEL VOCABULARY:
・{乗|の}り{換|か}え{駅|えき} (transfer station)
・{直通|ちょくつう} (direct, non-stop—opposite concept)
